transcript: Speaker A: I haven't sent a text message at the gym for the last six months. The last thing I want to do at the gym when I walk in is send a text message. This app allows you to just tap and talk. Log a set, text a gym bro, do everything four times faster. Perfect for gym-goers, athletes, even Pilates girlies. Give it a try and download Whisperflow for free today.
on_screen_text: The gym app you didn't know you needed. 4x faster than typing. Log a set, text a gym bro, do everything 4x faster than typing.
summary: A fitness enthusiast demonstrates Whisperflow, a voice-to-text app that eliminates typing at the gym. He shows how it logs sets and sends texts four times faster, ending with a call to download it for free.
